family.description: This family includes BREX protein BrxB from Bacillus cereus, which is part of a type 1 BREX (bacteriophage exclusion) system, a system that provides immunity against bacteriophage, which allows phage adsorption but prevents phage DNA replication, without degradation of the phage DNA [[cite:PUB00093365]]. The exact function of BrxB is not clear.
family.name: BREX protein BrxB
